_about: Length, ask and format limits read by humanizer_check.py. Each kind names who owns its numbers. references/limits.md explains them.

resume.owner: Length is checked on the DOCX by verify_docx.py against generate_resume_docx.py's one-page word ceiling, so no copy here.

cover.owner: Application Documents Standard, Letter bank: a letter is 250 to 350 words unless the plan says why not.

outreach.owner: Working heuristic, not a Standard: Handshake and WayUp advice (one purpose, one small ask) and one unattributed reply-rate analysis, recorded in the Claude System Design, Writing and outreach evidence. Under 150 words matches the follow-up rule.

followup.owner: Implementation Plan, drafting-outreach Rules: a first follow-up stays under 150 words. A working heuristic.
